Right, you asked me to rank my own city, so here it is, and nobody is going to like it. The most overrated thing here, by a mile, is the big wheel by the river. You pay more than you would for lunch, you go up for twenty minutes, and what you actually see is roofs. That is it. Roofs. Meanwhile, the best thing I have ever eaten in this city costs almost nothing and comes out of a van behind the bus station. It is a cheese sandwich. I am completely serious. There is a queue of taxi drivers at seven in the morning and they are never wrong about food. So the rule I would give you is this one. Ask somebody who lives there, not the internet. The places with the most photos are almost never the best ones. They are just the easiest ones to photograph, which is a completely different thing.

And we are back, and today you have been telling us about the most overrated places in this city, and honestly, some of you are angry. Priya writes: I waited two hours outside that famous ice cream shop in July, two hours, in the sun, and it was the biggest letdown of my year. The ice cream was fine. Fine is not worth two hours, Priya says, and I think most of us agree with her. Then Marcus writes in to defend the old tower, which everybody on this programme keeps attacking. He says yes, it is touristy, yes, the gift shop is ridiculous, but it is still worth it, because it is the only place in the city where you see the river and the hills at the same time. That is a fair point and I am giving it to him. Tomorrow we turn it around: send me the most underrated place in this city. One message each, and give me a reason, not just a name.
